# Problem 2

## (a)

```{r}
bubble_sort = function(x, decreasing=FALSE) {
  n = length(x)
  if (n <= 1) {
    return(x)
  }
  for (i in 1:(n-1)) {
    for (j in 1:(n-i)) {
      if (decreasing == FALSE) {
        if (x[j] > x[j+1]) {
          temp = x[j]
          x[j] = x[j+1]
          x[j+1] = temp
        }
      } else {
        if (x[j] < x[j+1]) {
          temp = x[j]
          x[j] = x[j+1]
          x[j+1] = temp
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return(x)
}

set.seed(1)
x = runif(10)

bubble_sort(x, decreasing=FALSE)
bubble_sort(x, decreasing=TRUE)
```

## (b)

```{r}
quick_sort = function(x, decreasing=FALSE) {
  if (length(x) <= 1) {
    return(x)
  }
  pivot = x[1]
  if (decreasing == FALSE) {
    left = x[x < pivot]
    middle = x[x == pivot]
    right = x[x > pivot]
  } else {
    left = x[x > pivot]
    middle = x[x == pivot]
    right = x[x < pivot]
  }
  result = c(quick_sort(left, decreasing), middle, quick_sort(right, decreasing))
  return(result)
}

set.seed(1)
x = runif(10)

quick_sort(x, decreasing=FALSE)
quick_sort(x, decreasing=TRUE)
```
# Problem 3

## (a)

```{r}
numerical_derivative = function(f, x, h=1e-6, method="central") {
  if (method == "forward") {
    result = (f(x+h)-f(x))/h
  } else if (method == "backward") {
    result = (f(x)-f(x-h))/h
  } else if (method == "central") {
    result = (f(x+h)-f(x-h))/(2*h)
  } else {
    stop("Invalid method")
  }
  return(result)
}

f = function(x) cos(x)-x
fprime = function(x) -sin(x)-1

x = seq(0, 2*pi, length.out=100)

forward = numerical_derivative(f, x, method="forward")
backward = numerical_derivative(f, x, method="backward")
central = numerical_derivative(f, x, method="central")
exact = fprime(x)

plot(x, exact, type="l", col="black", lwd=2,
     xlab="x", ylab="Derivative")
lines(x, forward, col="red", lty=2)
lines(x, backward, col="blue", lty=3)
lines(x, central, col="green", lty=4)

legend("topright",
       legend=c("Exact", "Forward", "Backward", "Central"),
       col=c("black", "red", "blue", "green"),
       lty=c(1, 2, 3, 4))
```

## (b)

```{r}
newton_raphson = function(f, x0, fprime=NULL, maxiter=100,
                          h=1e-6, epsilon=1e-10) {
  x = x0
  for (i in 1:maxiter) {
    if (is.null(fprime)) {
      df = numerical_derivative(f, x, h=h, method="central")
    } else {
      df = fprime(x)
    }
    if (abs(df) < 1e-14) {
      stop("Derivative is too small")
    }
    x_new = x-f(x)/df
    if (abs(x_new-x) < epsilon) {
      return(x_new)
    }
    x = x_new
  }
  return(x)
}
```

# Problem 4

## (a)

```{r}
left_rectangle = function(f, a, b, n) {
  h = (b-a)/n
  result = 0
  for (i in 0:(n-1)) {
    result = result+f(a+i*h)
  }
  return(h*result)
}
```

## (b)

```{r}
trapezoid = function(f, a, b, n) {
  h = (b-a)/n
  result = (f(a)+f(b))/2
  for (i in 1:(n-1)) {
    result = result+f(a+i*h)
  }
  return(h*result)
}
```

## (c)

```{r}
simpson = function(f, a, b, n) {
  if (n%%2 != 0) {
    stop("n must be even")
  }
  h = (b-a)/n
  result = f(a)+f(b)
  for (i in 1:(n-1)) {
    if (i%%2 == 1) {
      result = result+4*f(a+i*h)
    } else {
      result = result+2*f(a+i*h)
    }
  }
  return(h*result/3)
}
```

```{r}
L
```

## (b)

```{r}
forward = function(L, b) {
  n = length(b)
  z = numeric(n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    s = 0
    if (i > 1) {
      for (j in 1:(i-1)) {
        s = s+L[i,j]*z[j]
      }
    }
    z[i] = (b[i]-s)/L[i,i]
  }
  return(z)
}
```

## (c)

```{r}
backward = function(U, z) {
  n = length(z)
  x = numeric(n)
  for (i in n:1) {
    s = 0
    if (i < n) {
      for (j in (i+1):n) {
        s = s+U[i,j]*x[j]
      }
    }
    x[i] = (z[i]-s)/U[i,i]
  }
  return(x)
}
```


# Problem 6

## (a)

```{r}
gaussian_kernel = function(x, y, rho=1) {
  return(exp(-rho*sum((x-y)^2)))
}
```

## (b)

```{r}
krr = function(X, y, lambda=0.0001, rho=1) {
  X = as.matrix(X)
  n = nrow(X)
  K = matrix(0,n,n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 1:n) {
      K[i,j] = gaussian_kernel(X[i,],X[j,],rho)
    }
  }
  alpha = solve(K+lambda*diag(n),y)
  result = list(X=X,y=y,alpha=alpha,rho=rho,lambda=lambda)
  class(result) = "krr"
  return(result)
}
```

## (c)

```{r}
predict.krr = function(object, newdata, ...) {
  X = object$X
  newdata = as.matrix(newdata)
  n = nrow(X)
  m = nrow(newdata)
  K_new = matrix(0,m,n)
  for (i in 1:m) {
    for (j in 1:n) {
      K_new[i,j] = gaussian_kernel(newdata[i,],X[j,],object$rho)
    }
  }
  return(as.vector(K_new%*%object$alpha))
}
```

## (d)

```{r}
plot.krr = function(x, ...) {
  X = x$X[,1]
  y = x$y
  x_grid = seq(min(X),max(X),length.out=200)
  y_pred = predict(x,matrix(x_grid,ncol=1))
  plot(X,y,pch=16,xlab="x",ylab="y")
  lines(x_grid,y_pred,col="red",lwd=2)
}
```
